negation_transformation.name: Post-Verbal Negation Shift
negation_transformation.citation: Nguyen Thi Hoa (2015), Woodward et al. (2009) on VSL Syntax
negation_transformation.description: In VSL, negation particles (không, chưa) typically follow the verb. The engine shifts negation to precede the verb in standard Vietnamese.

interrogative_formatting.name: Question Marker & Punctuation
interrogative_formatting.citation: Woodward (2000) Non-manual marking and sentence-final WH words in VSL
interrogative_formatting.description: Identifies terminal question markers (gì, ở đâu, ai, khi nào, phải không) and produces natural question phrasing with '?'

greeting_formatting.name: Greeting Formula Reordering
greeting_formatting.citation: Observed in 134 authentic phrase pages in tudienngonngukyhieu.com (/cau/)
greeting_formatting.description: Formats VSL greeting sequence [CHÚC MỪNG] [BUỔI SÁNG] [BÀ] into fluent Vietnamese with exclamation point.

social_formula.name: Thanking Formula Alignment
social_formula.description: Formats [CẢM ƠN] + RECIPIENT + [ACTION] into 'Cảm ơn RECIPIENT đã ACTION.'

frequency_adverb.name: Frequency Adverb Placement
frequency_adverb.description: Places frequency adverbs (thường xuyên, luôn luôn) before verbal predicate.

topic_comment.name: Topic-Comment Retention / Optional Reordering
topic_comment.citation: Calibrated: Vietnamese allows topicalized OSV structures (Bánh mì này tôi thích ăn)
topic_comment.description: Maintains topicalized fronting if natural in spoken Vietnamese; avoids forced aggressive reordering.

adjectival_predication.name: Bare Adjectival Predication
adjectival_predication.citation: Calibrated: Bare adjective predicates (Con chuột yếu, Màn màu trắng) are natural without forced 'rất'
adjectival_predication.description: Retains bare adjectival predicates without inserting unsolicited degree adverbs unless explicit in glosses.
